title: Caretaker Crisis and Emergency Rule
subtitle: Electoral deadlock, emergency governance, and political transition.
summary: Between late 2006 and 2008, Bangladesh passed through a severe caretaker-system crisis marked by disputed electoral arrangements, escalating street conflict, the 11 January emergency, and prolonged non-elected rule before returning to electoral politics.
heroTagline: The caretaker framework entered its most contested phase under emergency conditions.
whyItMatters: This period reshaped debates on constitutional design, election credibility, civil-military boundaries, and democratic resilience in Bangladesh.
